name: Fechika
source: The clerk at the swimwear store "Burukon TT", as well as the younger sister of Fechiko-san, who was a clerk in the previous part of Sukumizu. Fechika is a fan of swimwear and she's envious of the protagonist as he's surrounded by girls in swimsuits. This is a very extraordinary person, but she knows her job well.
